plain_english_policy: Shifting Medicaid beneficiaries from traditional fee-for-service to managed care systems

effects.rationale: Managed care is a private-sector delivery mechanism for Medicaid services.
Reducing traditional Medicaid benefits (e.g., fee-for-service) to accommodate managed care may constrain access or eligibility in practice, even if not explicitly stated.
Managed care often includes cost controls (e.g., prior authorization) that could limit service availability compared to fee-for-service.
